housing.summary: Numbeo reported A$1,687.50 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre (updated 19 June 2026): https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sunshine-Coast . Queensland's RTA caps a general-tenancy rental bond at four weeks' rent (represented as 1 month): https://www.rta.qld.gov.au/starting-a-tenancy/rental-bond . realestate.com.au lists Sunshine Coast rental properties: https://about.realestate.com.au/sitemap/queensland/

banking.summary: ANZ says newcomers need key ID such as a passport, an Australian residential address, an Australian mobile number and a tax identification number or equivalent: https://www.anz.com.au/personal/bank-accounts/everyday-accounts/migrant-banking/ . CommBank requires an original current passport and foreign-tax-residency TINs, followed by branch identity verification after arrival: https://www.commbank.com.au/moving-to-australia/banking.html
required_docs: current passport or other accepted primary identification
tax identification number for each country of foreign tax residency, if applicable
in-person identity verification after arrival for CommBank

schools.summary: Matthew Flinders Anglican College in Buderim states that its Advanced Mathematics pathway includes preparation for Cambridge IGCSE examinations: https://www.mfac.edu.au/prospectus/welcome-to-our-school/ . The Queensland Department of Education Schools Directory can be searched by school name or suburb: https://schoolsdirectory.eq.edu.au/

legal_admin.summary: Sunshine Coast arrivals enter Australia through Sunshine Coast Airport or Brisbane Airport, where under Australian law most passengers must identify themselves and complete an Incoming Passenger Card (IPC); the Australian Border Force provides the card on board or in the arrival terminal, it must be completed in English, and prescribed exemptions apply: https://www.abf.gov.au/entering-and-leaving-australia/crossing-the-border/at-the-border/incoming-passenger-card-(ipc)
legal_admin.registration_step: Complete and present an Incoming Passenger Card (IPC) when entering Australia; the card is provided on board or by the Australian Border Force in the arrival terminal, must be completed in English, and prescribed exemptions apply.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign-passport holder who is in Australia with a valid work-rights visa can apply free online for a Tax File Number through the ATO Individual Auto-Registration system: https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn/foreign-passport-holders-permanent-migrants-and-temporary-visitors-tfn-application

transport.summary: Translink is the Sunshine Coast public-transport network; fares are A$0.50 per journey and a visitor go explore card provides unlimited Sunshine Coast bus travel for A$1.50 per day, but no monthly-pass price was published: https://translink.com.au/travel-with-us/around-queensland/sunshine-coast . Resident-visa holders must transfer to a Queensland licence after living in Queensland for 3 months; requirements depend on the issuing country and may include tests: https://www.qld.gov.au/transport/licensing/driver-licensing/overseas/transfer . Eligible residents can enrol in Medicare online through myGov or with a Medicare enrolment form, using a current passport or ImmiCard and valid Home Affairs visa details: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/enrolling-medicare?context=60092
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Resident-visa holders must transfer to a Queensland licence after living in Queensland for 3 months; bring the overseas licence, approved English translation if needed, original identity and Queensland-residency evidence, and take tests unless exempt.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible for Medicare, enrol online through myGov or submit the Medicare enrolment form; online applicants must live in Australia and have a current passport or ImmiCard plus valid Home Affairs visa details.
